description: This Java class 'BluetoothDownloader' handles downloading files over Bluetooth connections within the FDroid project. It manages Bluetooth connections, requests file details, and streams file content from a Bluetooth server.

classes.name: BluetoothDownloader
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth-based file downloads, manages Bluetooth connections, and streams file data.

methods.name: isBluetoothUri
methods.description: Checks if a given URI uses the Bluetooth scheme and has a valid Bluetooth MAC address format.

methods.name: BluetoothDownloader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Bluetooth connection based on URI and prepares for download.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for the file content over Bluetooth.

methods.name: getFileDetails
methods.description: Fetches file details from the Bluetooth server, may return null if error occurs.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Determines if the remote file has changed based on cache tags.

methods.name: totalDownloadSize
methods.description: Returns total size of the file to be downloaded.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download operation by streaming data from Bluetooth connection.
